declared_input_scope: Deterministic in-process relational occurrence/execution/causal trace shadow for the adversarial small workload and TPC-H-derived SF0.01 Q6.
candidate_path: actual workload -> Core facts -> ValidatedSnapshot plus exact SnapshotValidation -> project_core_to_otel -> canonical trace
reference_path: same actual executor callbacks -> official OpenTelemetry Python SDK -> finished spans -> canonical native trace
multiplicity_semantics: One span per GenerationOccurrence plus one root span; Span Link arrays retain one entry per causal input occurrence without set collapse.
canonicalization_rules: Only random SDK IDs and wall-clock timestamps are replaced by deterministic semantic keys; complete canonical trace bytes are compared.
output_orthogonality_rules: Core-off/OTel-off, Core-on/OTel-off, Core-off/OTel-on, and Core-on/OTel-on ordinary CSV/JSON outputs must be byte-identical.
authority_rules: Candidate reads only ValidatedSnapshot and its matching exact validation proof; official SDK spans are reference-only; no OTel-specific Core field or secondary authority store is allowed.
